parole.significato: Suffix appended to words to create a masculine noun, usually denoting a person who does something, performer, age, athl…
parole.testo: By hybridization of the inherited Proto-Slavic *-ašь (as in bogàtāš (“rich man”), from *bogatašь) and the borrowed Hungarian -ás (as in pȁprikāš, from paprikás).
